in_greek.name: Πούλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: derived from the Greek word πούλλω (poulō), meaning 'to sell' or 'to traffic'. The name may have originally referred to someone who was a merchant or a trader, but it came to be used as a personal name due to its association with the idea of power and strength.

in_latin.name: Pauellus
in_latin.long_meaning: derived from the Latin word 'pauellus', a diminutive form of 'paus', which means 'to stop' or 'to pause'. The name may have originally referred to someone who was strong enough to bring others to a halt, but it came to be used as a personal name due to its association with the idea of power and authority.
